about: ChiliFirm audio made with ElevenLabs (Creator plan, commercial licence) on 2026-09-28. "gain" brings each file to a common loudness (sound effects and voice about -20 dBFS RMS, music about -26 so it sits under them), with the peak kept under -1 dBFS. Multiply your own volume by it.

music/rush.mp3.what: Upbeat Latin trap instrumental, 140 bpm, energetic but friendly, bright guitar, brass hits and shakers, for a busy shop rush in a cozy tycoon game, loopable, no vocals

music/theme.mp3.what: Laid-back hip-hop instrumental with Latin flavour: dusty boom-bap drums, warm bass, nylon-string guitar licks, trumpet stabs and hand percussion, 88 bpm, sunny and playful, for a hot-sauce farm tycoon game, loopable, no vocals

sfx/bell.mp3.what: shop door bell jingle, customer arrives

sfx/grow_hum.mp3.what: soft warm electrical hum of greenhouse grow lights, calm

sfx/pluck.mp3.what: plucking a ripe chilli pepper off the plant, crisp snap

sfx/register.mp3.what: cash register ka-ching, bright and satisfying

sfx/sizzle.mp3.what: hot pepper sauce sizzling in a pan

sfx/water.mp3.what: watering can pouring water onto soil in a pot, gentle
